_about: What a 0 in a government Level 1.5 column means for the vehicle facts API (src/facts). The registry stores 0 for 'not recorded' in some columns. MILO private rows (catalog_variants_current, 2026-10): airbags > 0 in 96-100 % of rows; towing braked > 0 in only 24 % (< 2010), 84 % (2010-2016) and 79 % (2017+); the ADAS flags empty for 99 % of < 2010 rows. zero_means: `value` (0 is the value) or `unknown` (the field is left out of the record); `value_when` {government field: [values]} makes a 0 the value only when the row's own field has one of those values (engine_cc 0 is the value for a battery-electric car only). A government field not listed here is treated as `unknown` for 0. ADAS flags: a flag appears only when decode_equipment reports it as stated (equipment_stated); a flag that is not stated is unknown, never 'absent'. Reviewer-edited data: the code infers nothing beyond it.
